caption: An observer watches the bottom cane block: it fires at every growth step and when the cane grows. Its pulse reaches the piston through a stone and the dust on it; the piston head breaks the cane's second block and shoves the item onto a hopper that drops it into the chest. A stone caps the cane at two blocks, so nothing falls onto the farm from above. Water: a waterlogged waxed copper grate beside the soil (it holds its water in). Copies stand side by side, 5 blocks apart.
